name: RICHFISH Species-Aware Calendar Profiles
purpose: Forward planning profiles for species-specific calendar fit. These are planning indices, not catch probabilities, and do not override regulations, access, safety, water-quality advisories, or the live Fish Now engine.

striped-bass.label: Striped bass

season.basis: Catalog summary: often strongest during spring and fall movements.

striped-bass.notes: Favor meaningful moving water, structure/current seams, bait presence and low-light overlap.

california-halibut.label: California halibut

season.basis: Catalog summary: usually targeted most heavily from spring through fall.

california-halibut.notes: Favor moderate incoming movement over sand/mud flats, channel edges and bait concentrations.

starry-flounder.label: Starry flounder

season.basis: Species-specific seasonal module is not yet source-complete; neutral seasonal weighting is used rather than inventing a peak season.

starry-flounder.notes: Lower-confidence calendar model until the species seasonal/technique research module is completed.

white-sturgeon.label: White sturgeon

season.basis: Catalog summary says availability varies with regulation, freshwater outflow, water temperature and migration; no season boost is applied without a current legal gate.

white-sturgeon.notes: Planning context only until current CDFW season, possession, report-card and emergency rules are verified.
